title: Optimum Nutrition Isolate Chocolate Milkshake 2.28kg $134.44 @ Chemist Warehouse
body:
Deal: Optimum Nutrition Isolate Chocolate Milkshake 2.28kg $134.44 @ Chemist Warehouse

[lostinsydney] $121 Subscribe & Save on https://www.amazon.com.au/gp/product/B0F7RLBMT9/ or https://www.amazon.com.au/gp/product/B0F7RHVFC4
btw how does this stack up against Gold Standard 100% Isolate?
[richardhead] Thank you! going to refund my order tomorrow from chemist warehouse lol
Was wondering why this one looked so different from the regular ON brand. From claude:
'The real difference is that with Gold Standard, a portion of the isolate is hydrolysed, meaning it’s broken down into smaller amino acid chains. ON markets this as faster digesting. In practice, a regular isolate is already fast-absorbing, so the hydrolysed portion is unlikely to make a noticeable difference to your results. Gold Standard is also marginally leaner: about 0.5g of fat and 1g of carbs per serve, versus 1g of sugar and 1g of fat for Performance Isolate. Those gaps are tiny, under 10 calories.'
[lostinsydney] Performance is 74% protein and has more additives whereas Gold is 82% protein
[Oh Boy] Yup but gold standard isolate is also $109.99 for 750gm. Not must gain for the price difference.
[LurkMoar] What, it's 3g of carbs for performance wpi vs 1g of carbs on Gold Standard.
The performance wpc is 8g of carbs.
May not be that different for some but if you are trying a low carb diet it's meaningful.
[samp365] How does it compare with Musashi 100% Whey? Never used anything apart from this brand.
[holla4adollar] Worse, especially when you compare it with the Musashi Vanilla flavour
[sajidmib] Cant get any decent prices anywhere in protein tubs market nowadays.
Used to secure BSN Syntha 6 at $99 and ON at $105, now nothing near to that price, plus supplements are expensive.
[rahuahuj] ON performance isolate - $5.31 per 100g
ON gold isolate - $9 per 100g
So I bought performance.
[Wolfenstein98k] Stick with Musashi or INC on their half price deals.
